Connor —

Thanks for the heads-up. Proposed save/retention approach:
1) Pricing: produce a 24mo two-tier quote — (A) committed baseline with 20% uplift and modest 10% term discount, (B) performance pilot (30 days) with a 15% pilot discount and guaranteed throughput SLA for pilot window.
2) Bakeoff checklist (draft):
   - Metrics: p50/p95 token latency, tokens/sec, cold-start time, per-request cost, end-to-end app latency with their frontend. Knock-outs: p95 > 350ms or error rate > 0.5%.
   - Data: run on their anonymized subset (they sent current_usage_snapshot.csv) + a synthetic high-concurrency replay for the 8k RPS profile.
   - Environment: we can provide a dedicated nodepool on our Dedicated tier for the runs, with KV cache warm-up and recommended long-sequence kernel.
3) Operational commit: roll a short term SLA addendum for the pilot window (one-page) we can sign quickly.

I'll draft the bakeoff checklist and the pilot SLA. Ben — need final OK on nodepool reservation and whether we can commit to the p95 target for the pilot. Priyom — need pricing flexibility confirmation (ok to offer 10% term discount + 15% pilot discount).

If procurement pushes formal RFP this week we should opt into a hybrid plan: pilot now, full bakeoff at renewal.

Marissa
Sales Director — Redwood Inference

All —

We can provision a dedicated 4-node V100-equivalent pool for the pilot with autoscale headroom. Given their 8k RPS profile and the workload characteristics in the CSV, I think we can meet p95 < 300ms with warmed KV cache and batching tuned to their median seq len. We should avoid committing to p95 under cold-starts — propose we carve the SLA to apply after a 2-hour warm-up window.

Operational notes for the bakeoff runbook:
- We'll supply a runbook and a small helper container that replays their traces.
- Redwood will provide an engineer (2 days) to help run and validate results.
- We'll instrument tracing spans so they can see tail latency sources.

I'll queue the nodepool and get a cost delta for the 24mo committed baseline + 20% uplift. Estimated delta vs current: +18% list, net after discounts ~ +6%.

Ben
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
